project_type: Roblox Luau game (Pet Simulator / Battle Cats hybrid)

test_framework: None - Roblox game project, validation is via Luau syntax and generate_rbxlx.py
verification_instructions: Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py from project root and confirm it exits 0 and produces BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is generated by tools/generate_rbxlx.py from src/ tree

environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio runtime available - validation is limited to syntax checks and successful generation of .rbxlx

key_patterns: EffectsController uses TweenService for animations. ScreenGui-based overlays exist (see showLevelUpCelebration, showCritButtonHitEffect).
